limitations: Source-derived candidate; no local efficacy validation.
Original typed source inventory is not normalized; retain source identities and limits in the procedure/readsets.

applicability.scope: Checkpoint onboarding for LLM/VLM adapters on Ascend: weight/scale loading, KV-head replication under tensor parallelism and staged multimodal feature checks.
applicability.prerequisites: Check the installed CANN and checkpoint format against the versioned guidance; final sign-off requires real weights and at least one full-layer validation.
applicability.input_contract: Checkpoint weights/configuration and scale keys, attention-head/TP configuration, model modalities and expected graph/capacity features.
applicability.produced_artifact: A checkpoint/feature report separating dummy and real-weight evidence, applicable feature outcomes, and theoretical versus demonstrated serving capacity.
applicability.failure_modes: Dummy-only success misses scale/remapping/sharding defects; blindly sharding replicated KV heads or accepting reduced-layer results can conceal loading or full-model failures.
applicability.refusal_point: Stop on missing FP8 paired scale keys, unsupported tensor parallel KV-head split without replication, unverified multimodal visual encoder output, or failed base endpoint validation.

recommendations: Gate onboarding in order: dummy architecture check, real-weight loading, model endpoint, text request and then multimodal request when the model supports VL; retain the evidence each stage actually supplies.
Check weight/scale pairing and each attention tensor loading path, especially when TP exceeds the KV-head count; verify historical FP8 guidance against the actual stack.
Expand capacity/concurrency only after basic modality and expected replay checks; mark MoE-only features inapplicable for non-MoE models and require full-layer validation before sign-off.
